title: Recruitment case: a new branch manager, and justify frame
subject: Business
source: Written for business/y11 lesson 33 (Pupil PDF worksheet: recruitment case and justify frame)
intro: Lesson 33. Read the case and the data, then justify your choice.

passage.title: Barakah Grill
paras: Barakah Grill is a growing chain of five halal restaurants. A sixth branch opens in 10 weeks and needs a branch manager.
Option 1: promote Yusuf, an assistant manager at the busiest branch for three years. Staff like him and he knows the menu and systems well, but he has never managed a whole restaurant or its budget.
Option 2: recruit externally. An advert in a hospitality magazine and interviews would take about 8 weeks. The owners hope to find someone who has run a larger restaurant and could bring new ideas.
passage.source: All businesses, people and figures in this case are fictional, made up for practice.

blocks.text: Justify whether Barakah Grill should recruit internally or externally. (9 marks)

frame.label: Because (use the data)
frame.prompt: Give a reason and develop it into a chain, using figures from the case.

frame.label: However (the other option)
frame.prompt: Give the strongest point for the other option and develop it.

frame.label: Overall, why my choice beats it
frame.prompt: Compare the two: why your option is better for THIS business.

markScheme.a: Internal: £3,500 cheaper to recruit and £6,000 a year less in salary, ready in 2 weeks with 10 to go, motivates staff; but no management experience and his old branch needs a new assistant. External: experience and new ideas, but 8 weeks is close to the opening date and costs more. Level 3 (7-9): a justified choice that uses the data, with developed chains of reasoning and a comparison showing why it beats the other option. Level 2 (4-6): reasons for the choice in context but little comparison. Level 1 (1-3): generic points.
